author: MWA
quote: Everything that made ZOOT great is still preserved but overlaid with fresh graphical polish and some QOL improvements, only caveat is that for those of us that have played previously the boss fights are going to be too easy but anyone thats never played before is in for the game of a lifetime.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: MWA
quote: Just terrible.... Cinema gave us Gollum decades ago and yet the gaming industry gods at rockstar are getting away with this slop with a 13 year development cycle and 2 billion budget (guess a lot of that went on bribes) and getting patted on the back by all the stooge reviewers. It's uncanny valley overload, with terrible character movement and wooden facial expressions plus it only barely managers 30 FPS on a full fat latest gen console and it's absolutely riddled with bugs. This is a choreathon, not in a good way like harvest moon but in an awful crap padding filler mobile game sort of way. Needless to say we all know never to trust the gaming press ever again. Postman Pat on the 8 and 16 bits was more exciting and believable

author: MWA
quote: What a load of typical PC RPG crap, got **** in by the glowing reviews into thinking maybe these games had evolved and this would actually be enjoyable but its the same crap overhead pseudo isometric view, the same teenage character design aesthetics, usual rubbish user interface and battle mechanics. Instantly regrettable and forgettable purchase. Baldurs Gate, NOX, Sacred, Guildwars, all the same boring rubbish and Divinity gets added to that **** not the worst of the bunch but its certainly not the revolutionary or best RPG the professional reviewer would lead you to believe it is
game_title: Divinity: Original Sin II - Definitive Edition

author: MWA
quote: Pretty awful zelda wannabe, reminds me exactly why i dont miss third party publishers supporting Nintendo consoles more fully. I bought it on sale from the eshop for only £10 but after an hour or so with it feel i want a refund it's barely worth a single quid in my opinion. Graphics are merely ok and everything else from sound to gameplay and storyline is very poor indeed
